description: Carries out an action prepared by delete_address, delete_quote, email_quote, request_custom_quote, send_invite, prepare_checkout (placing the order), cancel_order, request_reorder, approve_order or reject_order, after the customer has seen its summary and said yes. Pass its confirmation_token and a new UUID as idempotency_key; retrying with the same key returns the first outcome and never acts twice. Never call it without the customer's agreement. Needs a signed-in Printdash account: called without one, the connection asks the customer to sign in on printdash.io.

confirmation_token.description: The confirmation_token a prepare tool returned.

idempotency_key.description: A UUID you generate for this confirmation; reuse it only to retry the same one.

name: confirm
title: Confirm a prepared action
